en.headline: Chris Tang says Huanggang Port drills smooth, more tests planned
en.dek: The Security Bureau chief said the first two large-scale drills at the Hong Kong side of the redeveloped Huanggang Port went smoothly overall and that further improvements will focus on signage and the public transport interchange.
body: Secretary for Security Chris Tang said on Monday that the two large-scale drills held so far at the Hong Kong Port Area of the redeveloped Huanggang Port had gone smoothly overall. The exercises, held on 13 and 15 August with about 1,000 and 5,000 civil servants respectively, tested passenger and vehicle flows, counter-terrorism responses and other scenarios.

Tang told a radio programme that areas identified for improvement included clearer signage and better crowd and vehicle management at the public transport interchange. He said there was still capacity to handle higher passenger numbers.

A further drill involving 10,000 people and 1,000 vehicles is scheduled for Saturday 22 August, with a later exercise aiming for up to 20,000 participants. Tang said the government would continue refining arrangements and discuss the formal opening date with Shenzhen only when operations can be ensured to be safe and smooth.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強：皇崗口岸兩次演練整體暢順 將改善指示及交匯處安排
zh.dek: 保安局局長鄧炳強表示，新皇崗口岸港方口岸區首兩次大型演練整體暢順，會加強指示牌及改善公共交通交匯處排隊與車流管理。
body: 保安局局長鄧炳強星期一表示，新皇崗口岸港方口岸區本月13日及15日舉行的兩次大型演練整體暢順。兩次演練分別動員約1,000名及5,000名公務員，測試聯檢大樓人流車流、反恐及旅客不適等情景。
鄧炳強在電台節目指出，測試中發現需改善之處，包括加強指示，以及在公共交通交匯處改善排隊及車輛運作安排。他表示人流處理仍有空間再增加。
本周六（22日）將再動員約1萬人及1,000輛車進行演練，其後一次期望提升至2萬人。鄧炳強說，當局會繼續優化安排，待確保安全暢順後才與深圳方面商討正式開通日期。
